verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev has first-class scheduled/cron task support (docs-5) with community confirmation that it 'just works exactly as expected' (comm-16), plus surrounding automation features like retries, queues, concurrency limits, and durable run lifecycle management that reinforce recurring workflow automation. This is well documented and independently corroborated, though missing for 10: more granular docs on schedule editing/timezone handling or advanced calendar-based scheduling beyond cron.
